item.title: Website downloader
item.description:
## The Problem
Manually saving a website for offline use is tedious and error-prone. Standard browser "Save As" misses dynamically loaded assets, breaks relative links, and fails on sites with complex resource graphs. You need a complete, recursive mirror with all CSS, JavaScript, and images intact, bundled into a single archive.
## What This Does

item.title: ipblocklist
item.description:
## The Problem
Firewall administrators need current, actionable IP reputation data to block malicious inbound traffic (scanners, brute-forcers) and outbound connections to C2 servers and malware infrastructure. Maintaining such lists by hand is impractical — sources change constantly, and aggregating them without blocking legitimate services (like public DNS resolvers) requires ongoing curation.
## What This Does

item.title: homelab hub
item.description:
## The Problem
Home labs accumulate scattered infrastructure — VMs on one hypervisor, apps on another, storage and shares in separate tools, network topology in a spreadsheet. Tracking relationships between these entities (which VM runs which app, which storage hosts which share) becomes manual and error-prone. This repo is a self-hosted single-pane-of-glass for that inventory, with a network map to visualize how things connect.

item.title: LuxTTS
item.description:
## The Problem
Existing TTS models force a triage between voice cloning quality, generation speed, and VRAM footprint. Most high-quality systems require 10GB+ VRAM and realtime-or-slower inference, while lightweight models cap at 24khz audio and lower cloning fidelity. This repository addresses the gap of achieving SOTA voice cloning quality competitive with models 10x larger, at 150x realtime speed, constrained to 1GB VRAM with 48khz output.
